architecture.when: package boundaries, system design, or ownership

software-concept.when: overall robot software concept, missions, fetch and bring, drive to room, places, operating modes, movement authority, stage plan, or what to build next

transfer-record.when: a source candidate, historical transfer record, or detailed transfer constraints need review

drivebase.when: ESS23-RS drivebase, Modbus, encoder odometry, chassis measurements, or drive commissioning

lidar.when: STL-27L LiDAR, scan normalization, LiDAR frames, masks, blind sectors, slot webs, or LiDAR commissioning

navigation.when: Nav2, robot_navigation, footprint, costmaps, localization, or navigation commissioning

mapping-app.when: manual mapping, gamepad or DualShock driving, teleoperation, map saving, map versions, rooms, room overlay, or the HomeMy app

app.when: iPhone app, Swift, SwiftUI, rosbridge, app bridge contract, mapping-mode switch, stop button, mock bridge, robot side of the app, map store, room manager, or app simulation

imu.when: HWT601 IMU, yaw rate, gyro bias, tile joints, encoder and IMU fusion, EKF odometry, or IMU commissioning

obstacle-protection.when: STL-27L obstacle protection, OAK-D-S2 depth, protection volumes, local safe stop, or OAK commissioning

semantic-perception.when: YOLO, Grounding DINO, SAM2, RGB-D object segmentation, grasp candidates, or manipulation perception

power.when: battery, battery monitor, INA228, shunt, LM74930, MOSFET power path, power button, DC/DC converter, regeneration, brake chopper, LED status, CAN power telemetry, or shutdown hardware

pmu.when: GPT Astra PMU core schematic capture, Revision-A prototype, power topology, protection coordination, power controller, or regeneration design

pmu-astra-start.when: starting GPT Astra to create the complete PMU Revision-A KiCad schematic, PCB layout, BOM, calculations, and prototype package

pmu-layout.when: PMU connectors, harnesses, component placement, PCB routing, Astra deliverables, or Revision-A and Revision-B release gates

pmu-requirements.when: machine-readable PMU limits, locked values, prototype assumptions, energization gates, or production-validation status

pmu-verification.when: PMU calculations, ERC/DRC review, bench bring-up, fault injection, thermal tests, or release evidence

runtime.when: ROS 2 packages, launch, simulation, or test setup

appliance.when: systemd, customer boot, developer mode, status LED, or power-on

ai-health.when: external AI health, remote AI availability, READY_LIMITED, or external AI outage handling

decisions.when: a design choice needs evidence or a rollback path

manual-drive.when: driving with the DualShock 4 controller, teleop, joy_node, controller loss, motion gate, reactive protection, or cmd_vel ownership

simulation.when: test stand, simulated drive, LiDAR or IMU, test apartment world, simulated operator, drive_sim profile, SLAM mapping in simulation, or end-to-end driving tests

robot-model.when: robot model, URDF, frames, base_link, CAD dimensions, footprint, OAK tilt in the model

missions.when: drive to a room, go_to_room, mission manager, Nav2, AMCL, localization on the saved map, localization ready, room navigation goals, or mission app UI
